fieldValues.title: A content question surfaced during build, after the holon's one sitting
fieldValues.summary: Holon #49 gathered owner questions into one setup sitting, including approving the help words. The code review of srs-web#650 then found that the approved order put 'Your name' ninth although a writer must name themselves before editing, and the question went back to the owner mid-delivery (answered 2026-10-29: move it up).
evidence: owner, 2026-10-29: We can move up "Your name"
fieldValues.body:
- Content the owner approves is reviewed for code, not for sense, before the sitting.
- Suggested change: in holon setup, run a review of the drafted content (its order and claims against the code) before it is put to the owner.
